description: DocLock evaluation set. 'direct' questions reuse the document's own wording; 'paraphrase' questions deliberately avoid it, so keyword search is at a disadvantage. 'evidence' must appear verbatim in the gold document (checked by backend/tests/test_eval_dataset.py). Unanswerable questions have no answer in the corpus: the correct behaviour is to say so.

questions.question: What is the sum insured under the policy?
questions.evidence: Rs. 5,00,000 per policy year

questions.question: How long must I wait before my existing medical conditions are covered?
questions.evidence: pre-existing diseases is 24 months

questions.question: Within how many hours must the insurer be informed about an emergency hospitalisation?
questions.evidence: within 48 hours of admission

questions.question: What is the claims helpline number?
What is the upper limit on the discount I accumulate for not making claims?
questions.evidence: maximum of 50% of the sum insured

questions.question: How early does the company warn me that my coverage is about to end?
questions.evidence: 45 days before the expiry date

questions.question: How much is the monthly rent for the flat?
questions.evidence: monthly rent is Rs. 18,500

questions.question: What penalty does the tenant pay for being slow with the monthly payment?
questions.evidence: late fee of Rs. 250 per day

questions.question: How long is the lock-in period in the lease?
questions.evidence: lock-in period of 6 months

questions.question: How soon does the tenant get the advance money back after moving out?
questions.evidence: refunded within 30 days after the tenant vacates

questions.question: How many persons may reside in the flat at one time?
questions.evidence: No more than four persons

questions.question: Can the owner walk in to check the flat without telling the tenant first?
questions.evidence: 24 hours prior notice

questions.question: What is the tuition fee for the odd semester?
questions.evidence: tuition fee for the odd semester is Rs. 85,000

questions.question: By which day should students settle their college dues to avoid any extra charge?
questions.evidence: last date to pay fees without fine is 20 August 2026

questions.question: What late fee does the college charge per day after the due date?
questions.evidence: late fee of Rs. 100 per day

questions.question: If a student leaves the institution early in the term, how much money is returned?
questions.evidence: 75% of the tuition fee will be refunded

questions.question: What is the minimum attendance required for the end semester examinations?
questions.evidence: minimum attendance of 75% is mandatory

questions.question: How much extra must a student pay to sit for exams if their attendance is a bit short?
questions.evidence: condonation fee of Rs. 500 per subject

questions.question: What can L1 regularisation do that L2 regularisation cannot?
questions.evidence: drive some weights to exactly zero

questions.question: What dropout rate is a common default for fully connected layers?
questions.evidence: dropout rate of 0.5

questions.question: How is the F1 score defined?
questions.evidence: harmonic mean of precision and recall

questions.question: For catching scams, which measure matters more: finding all the bad cases or avoiding false alarms?
questions.evidence: recall is usually prioritised over precision

questions.question: What constant k is commonly used in reciprocal rank fusion?
questions.evidence: k commonly set to 60

questions.question: Why do consecutive passages share some text when documents are split up?
questions.evidence: Chunk overlap prevents an answer that spans a boundary
